headline: Meta just created a moderation nightmare for its smart glasses
summary: Meta's smart glasses face severe privacy backlash. Users are filming unsuspecting strangers, causing public outrage. This creates a huge content moderation challenge for the company.

headline: Qualcomm is about to raise prices and that's bad news for everyone
summary: Qualcomm warns customers of upcoming double-digit price increases. The hikes will apply to products shipped after September 1st. The company blames rising supplier costs for the move.

headline: Midjourney bought the astrology app Co-Star
summary: AI startup Midjourney has acquired the personalized astrology app Co-Star. This move diversifies Midjourney beyond its AI image generation roots. Co-Star offers daily horoscopes and social features.

headline: DJI camera clone company Xtra is halting and refunding all preorders
summary: DJI clone company Xtra has abruptly halted all preorders. They are now issuing refunds for the new Xtra Muse 2 Pro. The company previously sold a copy of the DJI Osmo Pocket 3.

headline: Marvel Comics Makes Eddie Brock Venom Again | Comic Con 2026
summary: Marvel Comics is bringing Eddie Brock back as Venom. A new monthly series will launch in October 2026. This marks a return to the character's classic iteration.

headline: Halo: Campaign Evolved Secret Ending Cutscene Suggests a Halo 2 Remake Is on the Way
summary: A secret ending in Halo: Campaign Evolved teases a potential Halo 2 remake. Halo Studios seems to be hinting at the long-awaited project. Fans are excited by the prospect of a remastered classic.

headline: Incredibles Director Brad Bird's Long-Planned 1906 San Francisco Earthquake Project Could Become a Miniseries | Comic Con 2026
summary: Brad Bird's 1906 San Francisco earthquake project may become an eight-episode miniseries. The 'Incredibles' director discussed the change at Comic-Con 2026. This marks a shift from his long-planned film adaptation.

headline: DJI's Latest and Greatest Osmo Action 6 8K Video Camera Drops Below $300 for the First Time Ever
summary: The DJI Osmo Action 6 8K camera is now available for under $300. This marks the first time its price has dropped so low. Other retailers still list the camera at $439.

headline: Law student is charged over intercepted bomb in car
summary: A law student has been charged after a bomb was intercepted in her car. Her lawyer claims she was unaware of the explosive device. The incident is currently under investigation.

headline: Huge explosion and fire rip through Essex industrial site
summary: A massive explosion and fire devastated an industrial site in Essex. 100 firefighters battled the extensive blaze. A major incident was declared south of Chelmsford.

headline: Man describes trying to save mother and daughter who drowned off Essex beach
summary: A man recounts his valiant but unsuccessful attempt to save a mother and daughter. The pair tragically drowned off an Essex beach. He heard screams during a family trip.

headline: Andy Burnham's first week pledges - how much do they add up to?
summary: BBC Verify is analyzing Andy Burnham's first-week spending pledges. The report assesses the financial cost of his new commitments. It also scrutinizes how these pledges will be funded.
